perks.name: Firmly Planted
perks.description: Increased accuracy, stability, and handling when firing while crouched.

perks.description: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Headseeker
perks.description: Body shots landed with this weapon increase precision damage and aim assist for a short time. Body shots landed while the perk is active refresh the time.

perks.name: Disruption Break
perks.description: Breaking an enemy's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for a brief period.

perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.description: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Shield Disorient
perks.description: Energy matched shield explosion disorients nearby combatants.

flavor:
A visitor ignites the sky, and in the truth of light it dreams:
Above the dead and yet-to-die, a legion's blade with fire screams.
